python3 -c "
import json,re
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w28-20260925/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f2a1.json'))
p=d['payload']
pat=re.compile(r'%[-0-9.]*[a-z%]|#[A-Z_]+#|#\{[a-z]+\}#|<\?=.*?\?>|\n|\t|\[|\]')
for i,t in enumerate(p['translation_snapshot']):
  s=Counter(pat.findall(t['source'])); g=Counter(pat.findall(t['target']))
  if s!=g: print(i+1, dict(s-g), dict(g-s))
  so=[x for x in pat.findall(t['source']) if x.startswith('%')]; to=[x for x in pat.findall(t['target']) if x.startswith('%')]
  if so!=to: print(i+1,'order',so,to)
"
